description: Unchanged original renderer restart relay and checkpoint ordering tests with the complete pinned runtime import closure.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Minimal Node 24 environment; source renderer aliases/setup, feature-wall define, GC/webstorage flags and extended timeouts are omitted because this closure uses built-in Event/EventTarget/CustomEvent and in-memory spies only.
dependencyClosureNote: All runtime imports are pinned except electron and update/release types, which are type-only and erased. Node 24 supplies Event, EventTarget and CustomEvent.
isolationRationale: Only in-memory EventTargets, listeners, promises and Vitest spies execute. IPC is a caller-owned object double; no Electron process, filesystem, network, child process, updater, credential, service or user state is reached.
